% ss_bind_good.tex — study-guide shaped document against ss_bind.json:
% worked examples live in examplebox environments, each immediately followed
% by the tryitbox that re-parameterizes it (same skeleton, new givens), with
% the try-it's verified answer printed INSIDE the box, upside down, via
% \rotatebox{180}. JSON entries are listed in document order (example,
% try-it, example, try-it) and try-its carry "role": "tryit" — binding is
% positional. The box fallback must segment all four and PASS — this fixture
% guards the SKILL.md ss_ invocation of check_answer_key.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor, graphicx}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newmdenv{tryitbox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\begin{document}

\section*{Skills Summary}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} Factor $x^2 - 7x + 12$.\\
Two numbers that add to $-7$ and multiply to $12$: $-3$ and $-4$.\\
$\Rightarrow\quad x^2 - 7x + 12 = \ans{(x-3)(x-4)}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} Factor $x^2 - 9x + 20$.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{(x-4)(x-5)}$}
\end{tryitbox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} Estimate $\sqrt{2}$ to two decimal places.\\
$\sqrt{2} \approx \ans{1.41}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} Estimate $\sqrt{3}$ to two decimal places.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{1.73}$}
\end{tryitbox}

\end{document}
